adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the calendarId selection changed from `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.externalId ?? 'primary'` to `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, with fallback `|| 'primary'`. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when a destination calendar entry has no `credentialId`, it creates events for *all* credentials of that integration (`filter(c => c.type === destination.integration)`) and calls `createEvent(c, event)`; since those destination entries lack `credentialId`, Google’s `find(...credentialId...)` returns undefined, so every credential falls back to its own `primary`. Previously, a destination calendar externalId (even without credentialId) would be used, and mismatched credentials could 404 instead of succeeding, avoiding duplicates. This diff therefore can route events to unintended primary calendars and can produce duplicate events across multiple same-type credentials.
